notes.title: Weapon Crafting Preview
notes.content:
Just wanted to give you guys a quick update on the new weapon and shield crafting system:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8541082/f69a8370f95c32acc3b22888a2d6e74d1ea207a9.jpg[/img]

A few weeks ago Hugin got me the assets for the new weapons and shields and I have been implemented the new crafting systems as well as the new melee combat system. The new crafting system will work similar to the wand crafting system where each item will take two to four components to craft:

Weapons:
1. Handle
2. Blade
3. Enchantment (Optional)
4. Gem (Optional)

Shields:
1. Surface
2. Boss
3. Enchantment (Optional)
4. Gem (Optional)

Like with the wand crafting system the various components will contribute different things to the resulting item. For example, the handle type will determine whether the weapon is one-handed or two-handed and the blade will determine the types of attacks the weapon has.  The new system will have combo attacks, charged attacks, blocking, parrying, and other new features.

We're still in the early stages of getting the new systems up and running but we hope to have more news to share with you soon!

notes.title: New Character Models - Beta Branch Update v1.4.2

The new character models are here!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8541082/b67128657bd2fb69bf3cb162e0290d504ccaab31.jpg[/img]

The new human character models are now available in the beta branch. There are unique male and female models, each with many different attributes you can change. Alternatively if you would like to customize the appearance of existing characters you can use the console command /APP to change your appearance at any time.  In the future some of this functionality will be limited so make sure you make your changes now.

Also many NPCs in the game have been updated to use the new models.

Check it out and let us know what you think!

Note: Characters saved with this update will not be openable in older versions of the game so you may want to make backups of your saves.

-Fixed multiplayer crash bug

Update v1.4.2
-Moved face generation to background thread
-Fixed bug where "first person arms" would show up in appearance panel

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
I just wanted to share a development update with everyone. We are still very excited for the future of Counter Spell, even if the speed of development has slowed somewhat. Hugin is still hard at work at University, but the good news is he will be back working full time on Counter Spell this summer. Things will probably be pretty quiet around here until then, with only a few minor updates. Here's what we have planned for the big development push over the summer:

1.) Finishing up the new human character and NPC models and various class specific outfits.

2.) Expanding on the random dungeon generator to create above ground zones for the Reforged realm.

3.) Further refine the new skill and spell system and provide new, enhanced spell visual effects

4.) Implement a new difficulty system and provide proper progression for the Reforged realm

5.) Start expanding the weapon crafting into other weapon types

We can't wait to start exploring new zones and are looking forward to grouping up with everyone again!

-A new dungeon utilizing the random generator that features new assets, a unique story, and multiple boss fights

We are very excited to see these new systems come to life and can't wait to see what the future of Counter Spell brings!

notes.title: Content Manager Update In Progress
notes.content:
There will be no update this week.  I'm currently working on overhauling the content manager and it still needs more testing.  

The current version of Counter Spell simply loads all of the game's textures and models in at the title screen.  Only the world chunks are dynamically loaded in and out of memory.  As we continue to add more detailed content this technique is becoming impractical.

The next update will make all content dynamic.  This makes the game start up quicker and allows the game to use less memory.  Hopefully I will have this update finished by next Friday.

tags.feature: The next update will make all content dynamic.
